{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Cream linen blouse, relaxed fit with a slightly dropped shoulder and a loose A-line hem reaching mid-thigh, color #f0d6d2, fabric: natural linen.
Navy wool-blend wide-leg trousers, straight cut from high waist to ankle length just clearing the shoe, color #1a253a, fabric: fine merino wool blend.
Oversized structured blazer with notched lapels and vented back, cropped slightly above the hip line for a modern silhouette, color #0d1b2a, fabric: heavy cotton gabardine.
Tan leather loafers, classic penny style with a slight square toe, unlined for breathability in autumn morning air, color #c9a973, fabric: full-grain calfskin.
Matte black pearl-accented stud earrings, small hoops measuring 8mm diameter, color #000000, metal: oxidized sterling silver with faux cultured pearls.
Why this outfit works: This ensemble strikes the perfect balance between professional polish and approachable warmth for an autumn morning interview in a bank setting. The tailored blazer provides the necessary structure and authority expected in a financial environment, while the relaxed linen blouse softens the look to show personality and creativity—key traits for an analyst. The wide-leg trousers offer comfort for a long day of standing or walking during networking, and the neutral color palette ensures you remain the focal point without distracting from your answers.
